query: I am working in health/cancer research. What are the upcoming calls relevant for me?
response:
Health and cancer research is a major priority under Horizon Europe, primarily funded through **Cluster 1 (Health)** and the dedicated **EU Mission on Cancer**. Additionally, research mobility and frontier science are supported through MSCA and ERC.

Since specific upcoming calls (2025 Work Programme topics) are often released or fully detailed between June and October each year, I will outline the three key funding pathways and their typical timelines.

### 1. Cluster 1: Health (Collaborative Research - RIA/IA)

Cluster 1 focuses on improving health and well-being, covering a wide range of activities from preventative medicine and disease treatment to transforming healthcare systems. Cancer research is a significant topic within this cluster, often complementing the EU Mission on Cancer.

| Focus Area | Action Type | Typical Budget Range | TRL | Call ID Pattern |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Disease prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring | RIA/IA | €3 - €10 million | TRL 2-8 | **HORIZON-HLTH-*** |
| Health systems transformation and preparedness | RIA/CSA | €1 - €5 million | N/A | **HORIZON-HLTH-*** |

**Upcoming Timeline:** The next major set of calls for Cluster 1 is expected to open in **late 2024 or early 2025**, covering the Work Programme for 2025.

---

### 2. EU Mission: Conquering Cancer

This mission is a dedicated portfolio of research and innovation actions aiming to improve the lives of over 3 million people by 2030 through prevention, cure, and better quality of life. Calls under the Mission are highly focused and target specific societal impacts.

| Focus Area | Expected Outcomes | Action Type | Typical Budget Range |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Prevention (risk factors, early detection) | Implementing effective screening protocols | RIA/CSA | €4 - €8 million |
| Diagnostics and treatment innovation | Developing personalized, evidence-based care | RIA/IA | €5 - €12 million |
| Quality of life and survivorship | Addressing patient needs, palliative care | CSA | €1 - €3 million |

**Upcoming Timeline:** Calls related to the Cancer Mission are typically launched annually, often aligning with the Cluster 1 timeline. Watch for calls using the pattern **HORIZON-MISS-*-CANCER-***.

---

### 3. Cross-Cutting Funding for Researchers (MSCA & ERC)

These programmes support excellent individual researchers and are open to **any field of research**, including all areas of health and cancer research.

#### A. Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA)

MSCA supports researcher mobility, training, and career development. These are high-value opportunities for individual researchers (Postdoctoral Fellowships) or institutional networks (Doctoral Networks).

| Action Type | Focus | Status & Expected Deadline |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships (MSCA-PF)** | Individual mobility for experienced researchers (PhD holders) of any nationality moving to an EU/AC host | **Upcoming: September 2024 (Annual Call)** |
| **MSCA Doctoral Networks (MSCA-DN)** | International consortiums training PhD candidates | **Upcoming: November 2024 (Annual Call)** |

#### B. European Research Council (ERC)

ERC grants support exceptional researchers of any nationality who wish to carry out frontier research in EU Member States or Associated Countries. Excellence is the sole criterion.

| Grant Type | Career Stage | Typical Budget | Expected Call Launch |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Starting Grant (StG)** | 2-7 years post-PhD | Up to €1.5 million | Late 2024/Early 2025 |
| **Consolidator Grant (CoG)** | 7-12 years post-PhD | Up to €2 million | Late 2024/Early 2025 |
| **Advanced Grant (AdG)** | 10+ years track record | Up to €2.5 million | Early 2025 |

---

### Next Steps and Key Resources

To find the specific topics relevant to your research area (e.g., specific cancer types, specific diagnostic technologies), you must consult the official Work Programmes. 

🎯 **Getting Started with Health/Cancer Research Funding:**

1.  **Work Programmes**: Review the **Cluster 1 Work Programme** and the **EU Mission on Cancer Implementation Plan** for detailed 2025 topics and expected deadlines.
2.  **EU Funding Portal**: Register and use the topic search function, filtering by 'Programme Division' (Cluster 1, Missions) and status 'Upcoming' or 'Open'.

• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the [Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) (Filter by Horizon Europe, 2025)
• Learn about EU Missions: [EU Missions Portal](https://research-and-innovation.ec.europa.eu/funding/funding-opportunities/funding-programmes-and-open-calls/horizon-europe/eu-missions-horizon-europe_en)
• Visit the [MSCA Portal](https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/)
• Browse [Call Calendar](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar)
